PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Investment Banking professional with 7.5+ years of experience in
Product Control and Capital Markets across global financial
institutions. Proven expertise in partnering with Front Office, Risk,
Finance, Operations, and Technology teams. Experienced in P&L
reporting and attribution, trade lifecycle, Order Management
Systems (OMS), valuation controls, and Fixed Income, Equities, and
Derivatives. Skilled in stakeholder management, UAT, process
improvement, and automation initiatives that enhance operational
efficiency and strengthen controls.
WORK HISTORY
Macquarie Group Limited - Assistant Manager
Gurgaon, India • 03/2025 - 12/2025
Worked extensively with the Order Management System (OMS),
supporting trade capture, order lifecycle management, and post-
trade processing.
Partnered closely with the Front Office (Traders and Sales) to
resolve trade queries, validate trade bookings, and ensure timely
execution of business processes.
Produced and validated daily Product Control P&L for Fixed
Income and Credit products, ensuring timely and accurate
financial reporting.
Collaborated with Front Office, Operations, Technology, and Risk
teams to investigate trade breaks, system issues, and process
improvements.
Gathered and documented business requirements for
enhancements to order management and trade processing
workflows, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Supported UAT, validated system enhancements, and coordinated
with stakeholders to ensure successful production deployment.
Supported Prime Brokerage Back-Office processes, including trade
processing, reconciliation, exception investigation and resolution.
Worked on Prime Brokerage and Capital Markets processes, supporting
end-to-end trade lifecycle and post-trade activities.
Capgemini Technology Service India Limited - Consultant
Worked as a Business Analyst in Capital Markets domain with
exposure to Fixed Income, Equities, Listed & OTC Derivatives
within a global banking environment.
Collaborated with Front Office, Middle Office, Risk, Operations,
and IT stakeholders to gather and document business
requirements for reference data, trade lifecycle, and financial
reporting processes, ensuring alignment across teams.
Led automation initiatives to streamline static data setup,
validation, and reconciliation processes, reducing manual
intervention and improving SLA adherence.
Mapped AS-IS and TO-BE business processes to identify control
gaps and inefficiencies, recommending automation opportunities
across securities setup and master data workflows.
Conducted requirement-gathering workshops and prepared BRD,
FRD, functional specifications, and detailed user stories with
clear acceptance criteria in an Agile environment.
Deutsche Bank Group - Analyst
Supported the Investment Banking business by performing
Product Control activities for Credit trading desks covering HY
Bonds, IG Bonds, and CDS.
Partnered with Front Office Traders to validate daily P&L,
investigate valuation movements, and resolve trade-related
queries.
Performed daily T+1 P&L production, validation, attribution, and
reconciliation, ensuring accurate financial reporting.
Collaborated with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, and
Technology teams to resolve trade booking, valuation, and
reconciliation issues.
Worked with Order Management Systems (OMS) to support trade
capture, trade lifecycle, and accurate trade representation in
downstream systems.
Performed valuation controls, cash break investigations, and
balance sheet reconciliations to maintain a robust control
framework.
Supported Product Control system enhancements, UAT, and
process automation by collaborating with business and
technology stakeholders.
Conducted root cause analysis of P&L exceptions and
implemented process improvements to enhance controls and
operational efficiency.

exceptions through process training.

movements.
